I'll start by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

I'll write the files one at a time instead.

The top-level `Makefile.am` write failed with a transient EBUSY error, so I'll retry it.

The shell write worked. Next I'll build a clean copy in `/tmp` with the default configuration.

The default build and `make check` pass. Next I'll check install, uninstall, symbols, the pkg-config file, a consumer program, and the other configurations.

The default tree works at its prefix with no environment. I'll run the other configurations next.

All three configurations install and uninstall cleanly. Now I'll use the installed trees.

The failure is in my test harness: `run.sh` uninstalled the tree before I used it. I'll reinstall first.

The other three trees work too. Next I'll check a changed `VERSION` with a different interface version, then `make dist` and `make distcheck`, then a rebuild from the tarball.

I'll use short commands, starting with the version-change test.

The soname and version numbers follow the changed values. The one `make check` failure is probably the `version` case hard-coding 1.4.0, so I'll confirm that.

`make distcheck` failed, and `data/units.tsv` is missing from the tarball. `pkgdata_DATA` isn't distributed without the `dist_` prefix. I'll fix that and then look at the distcheck error.

It was the same missing file. I'll rerun the full dist script with the fix.

`make dist`, `make distcheck` and the rebuild from the unpacked tarball all pass. Last, a quick in-tree build check, then I'll write `STATUS.json`.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md`, and I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. I tested every configuration on clean copies in `/tmp`, so `/app` holds only the edited sources.

**Checks that passed**
- **Default build:** `autoreconf -fi`, VPATH `configure`, `make`, `make check` (2 of 2 tests passed), install and uninstall. Uninstall leaves no files, and nothing installed holds the `DESTDIR` path.
- **Other configurations:** `--disable-shared`, `--libdir=…/lib64` with another `--datarootdir`, and `--disable-tool` all build, pass `make check`, install and uninstall cleanly.
- **Installed trees:** I copied each tree to its prefix and ran `isodur` and `durfmt` with no environment variables. Programs built with pkg-config linked and ran, shared and static (`-lm` comes from `Libs.private`).
- **Dist:** `make dist`, `make distcheck` and an `autoreconf -fi` rebuild of the unpacked tarball pass, and an in-tree build also works.

**What was wrong and what I changed**
- **`configure.ac`:**
  - The version came from a hard-coded `1.3.2`, so it now reads `VERSION`.
  - `BUILD_TOOL` was only defined when the tool was enabled, so `--disable-tool` broke the build. It is now always defined.
  - The compiled-in data directory was passed to the program with a literal unexpanded `${prefix}`. `make` now expands it from `$(pkgdatadir)`, so the program reads `DATADIR/isodur`.
  - `data/Makefile.am` was never configured, so I added it to `AC_CONFIG_FILES`.
- **Interface version:** the `m4_define` lines are set to 1/4/0, so the library installs as `libisodur.so.1.0.4` with SONAME `libisodur.so.1`. `lib/Makefile.am` now uses `$(ISODUR_LT_VERSION)` instead of its own hard-coded numbers.
- **`lib/Makefile.am`:** it now exports only `isodur_` followed by a letter, links the math library, and lists `internal.h`.
- **Other `Makefile.am` files:**
  - Headers install into `include/isodur/`, and the VPATH include path covers the generated `version.h`.
  - `isodur.pc` goes into `$(libdir)/pkgconfig`.
  - The `durfmt` link now honours `DESTDIR` and is removed on uninstall.
  - `cli.test` is only run when the tool is built, and `CASES` points at the source tree.
  - The tarball now includes the test cases, `VERSION` and `data/units.tsv`.
- **`isodur.pc.in`:** all paths come from the configured directories, and `Libs.private` names the math library.

**Open points**
- **Interface version conflict:** `CHANGELOG.md` says `3:0:1` for 1.4.0, but `BUILDING.md` says `1:4:0`, which gives `libisodur.so.1.0.4`. I followed `BUILDING.md` because it is the contract.
- **Changed `VERSION`:** with a changed `VERSION`, the soname, `isodur.pc`, `version.h` and `isodur --version` all follow the new numbers. The fixed case `tests/cases/version.out` hard-codes `1.4.0`, though, so that one `make check` case fails when `VERSION` is anything else. I can't change the case.

command_result.command: cd /app && git status 2>&1 | head -3; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/BUILDING.md; cat VERSION configure.ac; cat Makefile.am; cat isodur.pc.in

cd /app && for f in lib/Makefile.am src/Makefile.am data/Makefile.am tests/Makefile.am include/isodur/version.h.in tests/cli.test docs/consuming.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; grep -n 'DATADIR\|config.h\|include' lib/*.c src/main.c lib/internal.h | head -40; ls -la; ls m4 2>&1
cd /app && cat lib/version.c lib/internal.h include/isodur/isodur.h; cat src/main.c; grep -n 'isodur__\|lround\|getenv\|DATADIR' -r lib src tests/unit.c | head -40; cat CHANGELOG.md docs/isodur.md
cd /app && cat src/main.c; grep -n 'isodur__\|lround\|getenv\|DATADIR' -r lib src tests/unit.c | head -40; cat CHANGELOG.md docs/isodur.md

cd /app && ls -la Makefile.am; lsattr Makefile.am 2>&1; mount | grep -i app; cat > Makefile.am.new <<'EOF'
ACLOCAL_AMFLAGS = -I m4

SUBDIRS = lib
if BUILD_TOOL
SUBDIRS += src
endif
SUBDIRS += data tests

isodurincludedir = $(includedir)/isodur
isodurinclude_HEADERS = include/isodur/isodur.h
nodist_isodurinclude_HEADERS = include/isodur/version.h

pkgconfigdir = $(libdir)/pkgconfig
pkgconfig_DATA = isodur.pc

CONFIGURE_DEPENDENCIES = $(top_srcdir)/VERSION

EXTRA_DIST = CHANGELOG.md docs VERSION
EOF
cat Makefile.am.new > Makefile.am; echo rc=$?; rm Makefile.am.new; cat Makefile.am

rm -rf /tmp/t && cp -r /app /tmp/t && cd /tmp/t && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | tail -15; mkdir /tmp/t/_b && cd /tmp/t/_b && ../configure --prefix=/opt/x >/dev/null && make 2>&1 | tail -15 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL|# |ERROR)'; grep ISODUR_LT ../../t/_b/lib/Makefile | head -2

cat > /tmp/run.sh <<'EOF'
# usage: run.sh name prefix [configure args...]
set -e
name=$1; prefix=$2; shift 2
cd /tmp/t; rm -rf _$name; mkdir _$name; cd _$name
../configure --prefix=$prefix "$@" >/dev/null
make >/dev/null 2>&1; make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'
rm -rf /tmp/D$name
make install DESTDIR=/tmp/D$name >/dev/null 2>&1
(cd /tmp/D$name && find . \( -type f -o -type l \) | sort | xargs ls -l | awk '{print $9,$10,$11}')
grep -rl /tmp/D$name /tmp/D$name || echo no-destdir-leak
make uninstall DESTDIR=/tmp/D$name >/dev/null 2>&1
(cd /tmp/D$name && find . \( -type f -o -type l \))
EOF
bash /tmp/run.sh a /opt/a; cd /tmp/t/_a; make install DESTDIR=/tmp/Da >/dev/null; cat /tmp/Da/opt/a/lib/pkgconfig/isodur.pc; nm -D --defined-only /tmp/Da/opt/a/lib/libisodur.so | grep ' T '; readelf -d /tmp/Da/opt/a/lib/libisodur.so | grep -E 'SONAME|NEEDED'

cat > /tmp/use.sh <<'EOF'
# usage: use.sh name prefix  (copies /tmp/D$name$prefix to $prefix)
name=$1; prefix=$2
rm -rf $prefix; mkdir -p $(dirname $prefix); cp -a /tmp/D$name$prefix $prefix
cd /tmp; env -i $prefix/bin/isodur fmt --style long P1DT2H3M4.5S PT90M; env -i $prefix/bin/durfmt --style short PT36H; env -i $prefix/bin/isodur --version; env -i $prefix/bin/isodur langs | head -2
cat > /tmp/app.c <<'EOC'
#include <isodur/isodur.h>
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){isodur_t d; char b[100]; isodur_parse("PT1.5S",&d); isodur_format(&d,ISODUR_STYLE_SHORT,0,b,100); puts(b); puts(isodur_version()); return 0;}
EOC
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$(ls -d $prefix/lib*/pkgconfig)
pkg-config --modversion isodur; pkg-config --variable=pkgdatadir isodur
ls $(pkg-config --variable=pkgdatadir isodur)
if [ -e $(dirname $PKG_CONFIG_PATH)/libisodur.so ]; then
 gcc -o /tmp/app_sh /tmp/app.c $(pkg-config --cflags --libs isodur) -Wl,-rpath,$(pkg-config --variable=libdir isodur) && env -i /tmp/app_sh; fi
if [ -e $(dirname $PKG_CONFIG_PATH)/libisodur.a ]; then
 gcc -o /tmp/app_st /tmp/app.c $(pkg-config --cflags isodur) -static $(pkg-config --static --libs isodur) && env -i /tmp/app_st; fi
EOF
bash /tmp/use.sh a /opt/a; ldd /opt/a/bin/isodur; readelf -d /opt/a/bin/isodur | grep -i path

cd /tmp; for c in "b /opt/b --disable-shared" "c /opt/c --libdir=/opt/c/lib64 --datarootdir=/opt/c/dat" "d /opt/d --disable-tool"; do set -- $c; echo "##### $c"; bash /tmp/run.sh "$@"; done 2>&1 | grep -v warning

cd /tmp; for c in "b /opt/b" "c /opt/c"; do echo "### $c"; bash /tmp/use.sh $c; done 2>&1; readelf -d /opt/c/bin/isodur | grep -i path; mkdir -p /tmp/Dd/opt/d/x; PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/Dd/opt/d/lib/pkgconfig pkg-config --static --libs --cflags isodur

cd /tmp; for n in b c d; do (cd /tmp/t/_$n && make install DESTDIR=/tmp/D$n >/dev/null 2>&1); done; for c in "b /opt/b" "c /opt/c"; do echo "### $c"; bash /tmp/use.sh $c; done 2>&1; readelf -d /opt/c/bin/isodur | grep -i path; PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/Dd/opt/d/lib/pkgconfig pkg-config --static --libs --cflags isodur
cd /app && printf 'dist_pkgdata_DATA = units.tsv\n' > data/Makefile.am && cat data/Makefile.am; cd /tmp/dd/_b && make distcheck 2>&1 | grep -n -B5 -A5 -i 'error' | head -50
bash /tmp/dist.sh > /tmp/dist.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -E 'ready for distribution|units.tsv|^# (PASS|FAIL)|Error' /tmp/dist.log

rm -rf /tmp/in && cp -r /app /tmp/in && cd /tmp/in && autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./configure >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'; ls -a /app; cat > /app/STATUS.json <<'EOF'
{"status": "success", "summary": "Repaired configure.ac (version from VERSION, BUILD_TOOL conditional always defined, interface version 1:4:0 per BUILDING.md substituted into lib/Makefile.am, data dir expanded by make) and the Makefile.am files and isodur.pc.in (header and pkgconfig install dirs, DESTDIR-aware durfmt link, symbol export regex, libm, VPATH test paths, dist of units.tsv/cases/VERSION, pkg-config paths from configured dirs); verified default, --disable-shared, lib64/datarootdir, --disable-tool, changed version, dist, distcheck and tarball rebuild. Note: the fixed tests/cases/version.out hard-codes 1.4.0, so make check fails that case when VERSION is changed."}
EOF
python3 -m json.tool /app/STATUS.json >/dev/null && echo ok
